title: SaaSify: Multi-Tenant Billing, Analytics & Provisioning Gateway
tagline: An enterprise-grade multi-tenant foundation providing database isolation, stripe billing integration, feature flags, and sub-domain routing.

problemStatement.overview: Bootstrapping new SaaS platforms requires duplicating complex boilerplate logic like subscription checks, tenant isolation, and invoice handling. SaaSify provides a pre-architected gateway to accelerate SaaS product delivery.
problemStatement.targetAudience: Startup Founders, Indie Hackers, Enterprise Web Teams
userPersonas: Full-stack developer building a new SaaS product.
Product manager needing flexible subscription tiers.

systemArchitecture.narrative: A Next.js application that uses PostgreSQL schemas or row-level security (RLS) to enforce tenant isolation. Stripe webhooks keep billing and access states synchronized.
systemArchitecture.dataFlow: Client Request -> Tenant Identifier Middleware -> PostgreSQL RLS Context -> Stripe Webhook Updates -> Tenant Dashboard UI.

core: Tenant Schema Isolation using PostgreSQL RLS.
Stripe Subscription Sync (webhooks and checkout portal).
advanced: Real-time usage meter dashboard powered by Redis Timeseries.

directoryStructure:
saasify/
├── apps/
│   ├── web/              # Next.js web application
│   └── api/              # Express backend handler
├── packages/
│   └── database/         # Shared Prisma definitions
└── package.json

roadmap.title: Tenant Separation
tasks: Configure PostgreSQL Prisma Client with RLS policies.

steps: Trigger Vercel main branch deploy command.

resumeBullets: Designed a multi-tenant SaaS starter kit supporting dynamic database row-level security (RLS) and custom subdomains, slashing bootstrapping timelines by 60%.

interviewQuestions.question: How do you guarantee a tenant cannot view or alter another tenant's data?
interviewQuestions.answerHint: Explain how PostgreSQL row-level security (RLS) automatically injects current tenant context checks into database queries.

title: Analytix: Customer Event Tracking and Funnel Analytics Engine
tagline: Renders real-time dashboards mapping users product navigation, tracking conversion drop-offs.

problemStatement.overview: Processing billions of user actions is costly. Analytix indexes data inside ClickHouse, compiling metrics summaries in milliseconds.
problemStatement.targetAudience: Product managers, growth marketing crews, SaaS companies leads
userPersonas: Growth lead tracking funnel checkout completion drop-offs

systemArchitecture.narrative: JS SDK pushes events. API writes entries to Kafka. Background consumers write batches to ClickHouse columnar database.
systemArchitecture.dataFlow: Browser event -> HTTP API -> Kafka topic -> Go consumer batch -> ClickHouse DB -> React analytics graphics.

resumeBullets: Developed real-time ClickHouse metrics analysis gateway processing 50M+ events daily in Go.

title: PassPortal: Enterprise Single-Sign-On (SSO) OAuth coordinator
tagline: Federates client access using SAML 2.0 and OpenID Connect standards, mapping Active Directories to application hooks.

problemStatement.overview: Managing employee log-ins across disparate corporate apps raises security breaches. PassPortal unifies access credentials routing.
problemStatement.targetAudience: IT managers, corporate enterprise compliance, cybersecurity heads
userPersonas: IT Admin onboarding new staff across corporate portals

systemArchitecture.narrative: Receives SAML request. Audits directory signatures. Signs JWT tokens passing tenant attributes details.
systemArchitecture.dataFlow: App login request -> SAML redirect -> Directory validation -> Signed token delivery -> Secure session write.

resumeBullets: Built OpenID Connect security identity federation hub managing tokens in MongoDB.

title: FeedbackLoop: Interactive User Feedback board and Roadmap portal
tagline: Allows customers suggest features, vote on roadmap cards, and receive automatic email status updates.

problemStatement.overview: SaaS builders struggle to coordinate feature requests. FeedbackLoop maps feature boards where users request, upvote, and track changes.
problemStatement.targetAudience: SaaS founders, customer success teams, product managers
userPersonas: SaaS user wishing custom import formatting fixes

systemArchitecture.narrative: A standard monolithic MVC. Uses Redis queues to manage transactional emails whenever a roadmap status card updates.
systemArchitecture.dataFlow: User suggestion -> DB write -> Upvote trigger -> Status update -> Redis task queue -> SendGrid email notification.

resumeBullets: Developed user feedback and roadmap portal utilizing Rails, PostgreSQL, and Redis background queues.

title: NotionSync: Collaborative Document Workspace with Offline replication
tagline: Renders collaborative page editors that save modifications local-first, syncing to Postgres on reconnection.

problemStatement.overview: Standard text editors lose modifications when internet drops. NotionSync merges simultaneous edits client-side using CRDTs.
problemStatement.targetAudience: Remote teams, content creators, productivity applications
userPersonas: Writer editing documentation on a flight

systemArchitecture.narrative: Updates write locally to IndexedDB. Synced edits transmit to backend web sockets server merging states in Postgres.
systemArchitecture.dataFlow: Editor typing -> local IndexedDB update -> websocket sync -> conflicts resolver -> Postgres write.

resumeBullets: Built offline-first real-time document editor utilizing Yjs, IndexedDB, and PostgreSQL.

title: CRMFlow: Automated Customer Outbox and Email Pipeline
tagline: A SaaS CRM system managing customer workflows, transactional sequences, and automated triggers.

problemStatement.overview: Sales teams duplicate efforts sending follow-ups manually. CRMFlow builds automation node trees triggering sequences based on user signs.
problemStatement.targetAudience: Sales teams, marketing agencies, SaaS growth operations

systemArchitecture.narrative: Triggers background tasks using Celery. Schedules email waves relative to lead sign-up status updates.
systemArchitecture.dataFlow: Lead signup -> CRMFlow trigger event -> Celery worker task -> wait delay -> send email sequence wave.

resumeBullets: Engineered transaction sequence triggers using Django, Celery background tasks, and Redis store.

title: SignDoc: Relational Digital Document signature hub
tagline: Enables corporate users upload PDFs, place signatures anchors, and securely invite clients sign documents.

problemStatement.overview: Obtaining formal document approvals is slow. SignDoc writes signature overlays directly into PDF file coordinates.
problemStatement.targetAudience: Legal offices, real estate, HR coordinators
userPersonas: HR manager sending employment offer letters

systemArchitecture.narrative: Invites clients. Renders signatures canvas overlay. Appends image pixels metadata directly into target PDF files.
systemArchitecture.dataFlow: Upload PDF -> Mark anchors -> Send signing invite link -> Sign on canvas -> Embed signature binary -> Save PDF.

resumeBullets: Developed secure signature overlay engine in Go processing vector PDF coordinate writes.

title: SupportGrid: Realtime Client Support Chat panel and ticketing Hub
tagline: Renders live chat widgets feeding tickets to a centralized dashboard via WebSockets.

problemStatement.overview: Handling client problems via email creates communication drops. SupportGrid provides instant chat widget connections.
problemStatement.targetAudience: E-commerce stores, SaaS websites, customer success managers
userPersonas: User seeking payment billing error refunds

systemArchitecture.narrative: Socket.io coordinates communication. Chats connect to support personnel. Ticketing metrics log to MongoDB store.
systemArchitecture.dataFlow: Chat client entry -> Socket.io connection -> Support dashboard routing -> Live conversation panel.

resumeBullets: Built real-time client support socket dashboard utilizing Socket.io and MongoDB database.

title: UsageMeter: SaaS API usage limit check and Billing dashboard
tagline: Tracks SaaS customer request volumes dynamically, enforcing access limit blocks.

problemStatement.overview: Metering API usage dynamically on heavy traffic creates massive database writes database bottlenecks. UsageMeter aggregates metrics in memory.
problemStatement.targetAudience: SaaS API developers, billing teams, infrastructure managers
userPersonas: SaaS architect tracking API key query quotas

systemArchitecture.narrative: Fast redis middleware intercepts requests, checks counts and writes increments. Compiles batches to PostgreSQL hourly.
systemArchitecture.dataFlow: Client query -> Redis key quote check -> request count increment -> Kafka publish -> PG batch update.

resumeBullets: Developed API billing usage limiter monitoring 2M+ daily requests utilizing Go and Redis.

title: CourseHub: Modular Learning Management portal with subscriptions
tagline: Enables creators publish video programs, gating access behind subscriber roles.

problemStatement.overview: Online teachers need simple frameworks upload videos, host pages, and process subscriber payments securely.
userPersonas: Tutor setting up a subscription programming class

systemArchitecture.narrative: Monages payments using Stripe. Connects video streaming coordinates using Mux API structures. Renders progress dashboards.
systemArchitecture.dataFlow: User registers -> Subscriber roles payment -> Mux video streaming API -> Video dashboard view -> progress save.

resumeBullets: Developed video LMS portal integrating Next.js, Stripe checkouts, and Mux Video APIs.
